name: nimbus-cloud-browser
description: Nimbus — secure 100% cloud browser with zero-knowledge vault (notes, passwords, cards) stored on your own Drive.

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace server && npm run build --workspace web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace server && npm run typecheck --workspace web
scripts.clean: rm -rf node_modules server/node_modules web/node_modules server/dist web/dist
